They use 'em as a base for pain killers on the Rim Worlds. These are medical supplies, Leia, they're&hellip;''"<br />"''&hellip;valuable, Mr. Solo. Valuable enough to provide the main source of revenue for the Exalted Torgaigne, as I gather the local crime syndicate is called.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Pandora Effect">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>}}
'''Phosovane salts''' were a base ingredient for [[Painkiller/Legends|painkiller]] medicines commonly used on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rim Worlds]]. They were the main source of revenue for the [[Torgaigne|Exalted Torgaigne]] crime syndicate, which operated out of [[Attahox]].<ref name="The Pandora Effect">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>

While he was supposed to be escorting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to a [[Rebel Alliance/Legends|rebel]] [[Rebels' Trade Conference|trade conference]] on [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] made a stop on Attahox to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] out some phosovane salts under the syndicate's nose. However, Solo's smuggling attempt was discovered by Torgaigne boss [[Vor Childermoss]], who pursued the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]] off the planet and into the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. <ref name="The Pandora Effect">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>
